questions.question: Which standard Railway Stores form is used for returning serviceable or scrap items from a user shop back to the Stores Depot?

options.A: Form S-1313
options.B: Form S-1539 (Advice Note of Returned Stores)

questions.question: How many copies of the Advice Note of Returned Stores (Form S-1539) are standardly prepared by the returning shop?

options.A: 2 copies

questions.question: Into which three main technical categories are released/returned materials classified by the Shop In-Charge?

options.A: New, Used, Old

questions.question: What is meant by a 'Serviceable Item' returned to the Stores Depot?

options.A: An item that is completely damaged beyond repair
options.B: An item fit for immediate reissue and use without requiring further overhaul or repair
options.C: An item that must be sold in public auction immediately
options.D: An item reserved for display only

questions.question: What is a 'Repairable Item' returned to Stores Depot?

options.A: An item that can be rendered serviceable after reconditioning or repair in the workshop
options.B: An item that can never be fixed
options.C: An item already scrapped by Survey Committee
options.D: An item imported from foreign country

questions.question: What is 'Scrap Material' in railway workshop terminology?

options.A: Brand new material received from vendor
options.B: Material that has reached the end of its useful life and cannot be economically repaired or reused
options.C: High-value spare parts stored in safety vaults

questions.question: When serviceable materials are returned to Stores Depot, at what rate is financial credit generally afforded to the returning work order?

options.A: Zero rate
options.B: Current book rate / estimated valuation rate

questions.question: When unserviceable scrap material generated during maintenance is returned to Stores, credit is afforded to the work order based on:

options.A: Current schedule of scrap rates fixed for that specific scrap category
options.B: Original purchase price of the brand-new asset
options.C: Basic pay of the shop supervisor

questions.question: Which accounting head is credited when scrap material generated from a direct production work order is returned to Stores?

options.A: Workshop Manufacturing Suspense (WMS) / Specific Work Order

questions.question: In Form S-1539 (Advice Note of Returned Stores), who certifies the correctness of the description, quantity, and weight of returned items?

options.A: Returning Shop Senior Section Engineer (SSE)

questions.question: Which ward in the Stores Depot receives and processes materials sent via Form S-1539?

options.A: Returned Stores Ward / Scrap Ward

questions.question: What document is issued by the Stores Depot Ward Keeper to the returning shop acknowledging physical receipt of returned items?

options.A: Receipted copy of Advice Note (Form S-1539) duly signed and stamped

questions.question: What is a 'Survey Committee' in a Railway Workshop Stores Depot?

options.A: Committee of officers appointed to inspect unserviceable equipment/scrap and declare them fit for condemnation/sale

questions.question: Which standard form is prepared by the user department/depot for submitting items to the Survey Committee for condemnation?

options.A: Survey Report (Form S-2269)

questions.question: A typical Workshop Survey Committee includes representatives from which departments?

options.A: Technical Department (Mechanical/Electrical), Stores Department, and Accounts Department

questions.question: Why is the presence of an Accounts Officer mandatory on a Survey Committee for high-value items?

options.A: To ensure financial concurrence, verify book values, and prevent premature condemnation of assets
options.C: To repair the machine on the spot

questions.question: What is 'Condemnation' of a workshop machine or coach component?

options.A: Formal administrative and technical declaration that the asset is beyond economical repair and fit for scrap disposal
options.D: Sending the asset to another railway zone

questions.question: What does 'BER' stand for regarding damaged machinery submitted for return/scrap?

options.A: Beyond Economical Repair

questions.question: If an asset has NOT completed its codal life but is recommended for condemnation due to severe damage, who must approve the Survey Report?

options.A: Competent Technical Authority (e.g., CWM / HOD / DRM depending on financial powers in Model SOP)

questions.question: What is 'Codal Life' of an asset?

options.A: The normal expected service life (in years) prescribed by Railway Board for various classes of assets
options.B: The warranty period given by supplier
options.C: The expiry date of lubrication oil

questions.question: Into which two major metallurgical categories is metal scrap classified in Stores Depots?

options.A: Ferrous Scrap and Non-Ferrous Scrap

questions.question: Which of the following is categorized as 'Ferrous Scrap'?

options.A: Melting steel scrap, cast iron scrap, worn-out steel rails, and steel turnings/borings

questions.question: Which of the following is categorized as 'Non-Ferrous Scrap'?

options.A: Copper, brass, bronze, aluminum, lead, and zinc scrap

questions.question: Why is Non-Ferrous scrap stored under strict security in locked godowns/bins in Stores Depots?

options.A: Due to its high market commercial value and high vulnerability to theft
options.C: Because it emits toxic fumes continuously

questions.question: What is 'Turnings and Borings' scrap?

options.A: Small metal chips, shavings, and swarf generated during machining operations like turning, boring, and drilling

questions.question: Why must oily turnings and borings be segregated from clean heavy melting steel scrap?

options.A: To prevent fire hazards and fetch maximum valuation during auction sale
options.B: To mix them with foundry sand

questions.question: What is 'Scrap Lot' formation in a Scrap Yard?

options.A: Grouping similar categories of scrap material into identifiable physical lots with estimated weights for auction
options.B: Digging deep holes to bury scrap
options.C: Building residential houses on scrap land
options.D: Mixing all types of scrap together

questions.question: What details are displayed on the 'Lot Board' of a scrap lot in a Stores Scrap Depot?

options.A: Lot Number, Description of scrap, approximate weight/quantity, and name of depot ward
options.B: Name of CWM and home address

questions.question: Which electronic portal is used across Indian Railways for conducting e-Auctions of scrap materials?

options.A: IREPS (Indian Railways E-Procurement System - e-Auction module)

questions.question: What is 'Reserve Price' in a scrap e-Auction?

options.A: The confidential minimum price fixed by the Railway administration below which the scrap lot will not be sold
options.B: The maximum price a buyer can offer
options.C: The price of brand new items

questions.question: Who fixes the Reserve Price for a scrap lot prior to auction?

options.A: Reserve Price Committee consisting of Stores Officer and Accounts Officer

questions.question: What is 'Earnest Money Deposit' (EMD) or Bid Security in e-Auction for scrap?

options.A: Deposit paid by prospective buyers to qualify for participating in the scrap auction

questions.question: What document is issued to the successful bidder after full payment of the auction sale value is deposited?

options.A: Delivery Order (Form S-2339) / Sale Order

questions.question: What is 'Free Delivery Period' (FDP) in scrap delivery?

options.A: Fixed period allowed to the purchaser to lift the auctioned scrap from depot without paying ground rent
options.B: Period where scrap is given free of cost
options.C: Period during which depot is closed

questions.question: If the purchaser fails to lift the scrap lot within the Free Delivery Period, what penalty is levied by Railways?

options.A: Ground Rent (storage charges per day/week on balance lot)

questions.question: If an auction buyer defaults on paying the balance balance sale value within the stipulated time, what action is taken?

options.A: Sale is cancelled and EMD / Security Deposit is forfeited to Railways
options.C: Buyer is awarded a contract medal

questions.question: How is scrap material weighed during loading and delivery at the Stores Depot gate?

options.A: Using certified Electronic Lorry Weighbridge (Gross weight minus Tare weight)

questions.question: What is 'Tare Weight' of a delivery truck?

options.A: Weight of the empty truck before loading scrap
options.B: Weight of truck loaded with scrap

questions.question: What is 'Gross Weight' of a delivery truck?

options.A: Combined weight of empty truck plus loaded scrap material

questions.question: How is Net Weight of delivered scrap calculated?

options.A: Net Weight = Gross Weight - Tare Weight
options.B: Net Weight = Gross Weight + Tare Weight
options.C: Net Weight = Tare Weight / Gross Weight

questions.question: Who must be physically present during the loading and weighbridge weighing of auctioned scrap material?

options.A: Stores Representative (Stock Verifier / Store Keeper), Accounts Representative, and RPF Official

questions.question: What document is signed jointly at the gate by Stores, Accounts, RPF, and Purchaser after weighing scrap?

options.A: Weighment Sheet / Delivery Pass / Gate Issue Memo

questions.question: What is 'Re-crediting' in returned store accounting?

options.A: Financial process of crediting the material value of returned serviceable/scrap items back to the originating work order or fund

questions.question: If released serviceable parts from POH of Metro rakes are re-issued to the shop floor, what procedure is followed?

options.A: Stocked as second-hand serviceable stock and issued against regular Requisition Form (S-1313) at valuation rate

questions.question: How are hazardous scrap items like used transformer oil, used batteries, and e-waste disposed of?

options.A: Sold only to CPCB / SPCB registered and authorized environmental recyclers as per statutory pollution laws

questions.question: What does CPCB stand for in environmental regulations governing scrap disposal?

options.A: Central Pollution Control Board

questions.question: What is 'Condemnation Certificate' for rolling stock / Metro coaches?

options.A: Official document signed by competent mechanical/electrical authorities certifying coach body/bogie frame fit for scrapping
options.B: Fitness certificate to run at 100 km/h

questions.question: When condemned Metro rolling stock is cut into pieces for scrap disposal, it is called:

options.A: Cutting and Scrapping of Rolling Stock

questions.question: Why are strict safety precautions and Hot Work Permits required during oxygen-acetylene flame cutting of scrap coaches?

options.A: To prevent shop floor fires, explosions from trapped gases, and burn injuries to workers

questions.question: What is 'Scrap Reclamation' in workshops?

options.A: Process of sorting through scrap to salvage usable components, bolts, or metals for reconditioning and reuse
options.C: Buying new scrap from outside market

questions.question: What is 'Reclamation Ward' or 'Reclamation Shop'?

options.A: Specialized section dedicated to retrieving, repairing, and converting released scrap into useful workshop items

questions.question: Which of the following items is commonly salvaged in a Workshop Reclamation Shop?

options.A: Usable tie bars, nuts, bolts, brake gear pins, and structural steel off-cuts

questions.question: What is 'Off-cut' steel material in fabrication shops?

options.A: Usable remaining pieces of steel plates, angles, or channels left over after cutting standard components

questions.question: How should usable steel off-cuts be accounted for on the shop floor?

options.A: Returned to Stores or transferred via Form S-1727 for smaller job fabrications instead of scrapping
options.B: Thrown into heavy melting scrap bin
options.D: Left lying in workshop yard unrecorded

questions.question: What is 'Advice of Material Transfer' (Form S-1727) used for regarding released/serviceable materials?

options.A: Transferring material directly from one shop work order/section to another without physical routing through Stores Depot

questions.question: Which form is used when returning unused excess stock material back to Stores Depot in original condition?

options.A: Advice Note of Returned Stores (Form S-1539) marked as 'Unused / Surplus Stock'

questions.question: If unused stock material is returned within the same financial month, how is the credit processed?

options.A: Credited back to the specific Work Order / Allocation Head from which it was originally drawn
options.C: Debited as penalty on shop SSE

questions.question: What is the function of RPF (Railway Protection Force) at the Stores Scrap Yard gate during scrap delivery?

options.A: Verify Delivery Order, check physical scrap loading against gate pass, ensure no unauthorized material is taken, and check weighment

questions.question: What is 'Gate Pass for Scrap Delivery'?

options.A: Official non-returnable security pass authorizing the scrap purchaser's vehicle to exit the workshop gate with weighed scrap

questions.question: Who signs the Non-Returnable Scrap Gate Pass before a loaded scrap truck leaves the workshop?

options.A: Authorized Stores Officer / Ward Keeper and RPF Gate In-Charge

questions.question: What is 'Survey Report for Condemnation of Machinery & Plant' (M&P)?

options.A: Technical report detailing machine age, working hours, cost of repair vs original value, and reasons for scrapping

questions.question: Who must sanction the condemnation of a high-value Machine & Plant asset costing above major Model SOP limits?

options.A: Head of Department (PCME / PCEE) / General Manager depending on financial limits

questions.question: What is 'Credit Slip' attached to Advice Note S-1539?

options.A: Accounts voucher acknowledging financial credit posted to the workshop allocation head for returned stores

questions.question: When serviceable tools are returned to the Tool Room by a worker, which document is updated?

options.A: Tool Issue Card / Tool Register (clearing worker's tool loan record)

questions.question: What happens if a worker fails to return a borrowed specialized tool to the Tool Room?

options.A: Cost of the lost tool is recovered from worker's salary after due verification
options.D: Tool price is debited to CWM

questions.question: In Metro Railway workshops, old traction motor copper coils removed during rewind are classified as:

options.A: High-grade Heavy Copper Scrap (Non-Ferrous)

questions.question: Why is heavy copper scrap weighed with high precision balances in presence of RPF and Accounts?

options.A: Because copper has very high market value and high risk of pilferage

questions.question: What is 'Scrap Lot Sample Inspection' by prospective bidders?

options.A: Opportunity given to registered buyers to inspect physical scrap lots in depot prior to auction date
options.C: Giving free scrap samples to buyers

questions.question: Can scrap materials be sold directly to railway employees for private use without public e-Auction?

options.A: No, direct private sale of scrap to employees is prohibited under Railway vigilance and store rules

questions.question: What is 'Melt Scrap' vs 'Serviceable Re-rollable Scrap'?

options.A: Melt scrap is fit only for melting in furnaces; Re-rollable scrap (like old rails) can be re-rolled into structural steel sections
options.B: Melt scrap is non-metallic; Re-rollable is wood

questions.question: Released rails from track renewals are classified into:

options.A: Class I (Serviceable for re-use), Class II (Serviceable with repair), and Class III (Scrap for auction)
options.B: Grade A and Grade B only

questions.question: Who inspects and classifies released permanent way / track materials before return to Stores Depot?

options.A: Permanent Way Inspector (SSE/P.Way) and Stores/Accounts Representative

questions.question: What is 'Stock Verification of Scrap Yards'?

options.A: Independent physical audit of scrap lot balances and registers conducted by Accounts Stock Verifiers
options.B: Counting leaves on trees in yard

questions.question: What is 'Discrepancy in Scrap Weight' during delivery?

options.A: Difference between estimated lot weight and actual weighbridge weight during lifting
options.B: Difference between driver age and weight
options.C: Difference between truck height and length

questions.question: If actual weighed quantity of a scrap lot is within acceptable variation limits (e.g., ± 10%) of auction estimate:

options.A: Purchaser pays or receives refund for actual weighed balance at bid unit rate

questions.question: What document is generated when returned material is rejected by Stores Depot due to wrong description in Form S-1539?

options.A: Rejection Advice / Returned Store Discrepancy Memo

questions.question: Why must shop supervisors ensure prompt return of scrap and released materials to Stores Depot monthly?

options.A: Prevents shop floor congestion, unlocks tied-up capital credit, reduces theft risk, and maintains safety & 5S hygiene
options.B: To increase paper filing in office

questions.question: What is 'Incineration' or controlled destruction of unserviceable non-metallic items (e.g., old uniforms/condemned records)?

options.A: Authorized destruction under supervisory board presence following environmental safety norms

questions.question: Which authority approves the write-off of material lost due to theft or fire in Stores Depot?

options.A: Competent Financial Authority (GM / AGM / PCMM as per Model SOP financial limits)

questions.question: What is 'Survey Register' maintained in Stores Depot?

options.A: Register recording all survey reports, items inspected, Survey Committee recommendations, and sanction details

questions.question: What is 'Lot Register' in scrap wards?

options.A: Register tracking formation, lot number, description, estimated quantity, e-auction date, sale order, and final delivery of scrap lots

questions.question: Which type of crane is commonly used in Stores Scrap Yards for lifting heavy ferrous scrap and wheel sets?

options.A: Overhead Gantry Crane / Mobile Hydraulic Crane / Magnet Crane

questions.question: Why are Electromagnetic Cranes specifically useful in heavy ferrous scrap yards?

options.A: They quickly attract, lift, and load loose iron/steel scrap without needing manual slinging

questions.question: What is 'Scrap Segregation' at source in workshop sections?

options.A: Practice of separating different metals (copper, brass, steel, aluminum) immediately at machine source before sending to Stores
options.B: Mixing all metals together in one container

questions.question: What is the financial loss of failing to perform scrap segregation at source?

options.A: High-value non-ferrous metals get contaminated with steel and are valued at much lower mixed scrap rates during auction
options.B: Increase in basic pay of staff

questions.question: What is 'Returned Stores Register' maintained by the Shop In-Charge?

options.A: Record book tracking all Advice Notes (S-1539) generated, items dispatched to Stores, and credit acknowledgments received from Accounts

questions.question: How are unserviceable lead-acid batteries disposed of by Railway Stores Depots?

options.A: Auctioned strictly to Ministry of Environment & Forests (MoEF) / CPCB registered battery recyclers under Batteries Rules

questions.question: What is 'Auction Catalogue' published before e-Auction on IREPS?

options.A: Official document listing all scrap lots, lot numbers, descriptions, locations, estimated quantities, and auction terms & conditions

questions.question: What is 'Post-Bid Clearance' in scrap e-Auction?

options.A: Formal administrative approval required from competent Stores authority before accepting bids below reserve price

questions.question: What is 'Defaulted Lot' in scrap management?

options.A: A scrap lot whose auction sale was cancelled due to purchaser's failure to deposit full balance payment
options.B: A lot containing brand new machines

questions.question: When a Defaulted Lot is put up for re-auction, any loss incurred by Railways is covered by:

options.A: Forfeited Security Deposit / EMD of the defaulting purchaser

questions.question: In Metro Railway Kolkata maintenance depots, worn-out brake blocks released from rake overhauls are classified as:

options.A: Cast Iron Scrap / Composite Synthetic Brake Block Scrap

questions.question: What document is processed to account for scrap generated during breakdown repairs on track or sub-stations?

options.A: Advice Note of Returned Stores (Form S-1539) credited to Revenue Maintenance Head

questions.question: Who holds administrative charge of the Central Stores Scrap Depot in a zonal railway / major production unit?

options.A: Deputy Chief Material Manager (Dy. CMM / Scrap) or Senior District Material Manager (Sr. DMM)

questions.question: What is 'Material Delivery Scrap Pass' (Gate Pass)?

options.A: Pass generated electronically upon full weighment verification authorizing gate guards to allow scrap vehicle exit

questions.question: What is 'Surplus Store Inventory' in Stores Depot?

options.A: Serviceable stock items that have not moved/issued for over 24 months and are deemed excess to future needs

questions.question: How does the Standing Surplus Committee deal with Surplus Store Inventory?

options.A: Recommends re-advertisement to other zonal railways/metro networks, conversion to alternative use, or scrap condemnation

questions.question: What is 'Material Valuation Rate' applied to returned serviceable components?

options.A: Assessed percentage value (e.g., 50-70% of book rate) based on remaining life and reconditioning cost

questions.question: Which accounting ledger records progressive credits received by a Workshop for scrap returned via Form S-1539?

options.A: Workshop Out-turn Statement / WMS Ledger

questions.question: Why is efficient processing of returned stores and scrap disposal critical for Railway Workshop Management?

options.A: Maximizes revenue generation, recycles materials, clears shop floor space, ensures vigilance safety, and optimizes maintenance costs
options.B: Increases clerical file storage in offices
